annotations: The owner, 2026-10-26: "Sheridan street between 3rd and 5th streets are 1 way in the opposite direction. That change isn't even on Google maps yet". A recent change that neither DC's Roadway Block layer nor OSM records yet. DC still lists both blocks as two-way (SUMMARYDIRECTION BD), and OSM has the 400 block one-way eastbound (way 1044281798, oneway=yes, drawn from 5th St toward 4th St) and the 300 block two-way (way 1044479731). With DC's two-way record the rebuild made the 400 block two-way (OWNER-DECISIONS 190, row C4). The owner's direction replaces DC's on both blocks: one-way westbound, from 3rd St toward 5th St, which is DC's OB (FROMSTREET to TOSTREET) on each. Where OSM's one-way runs the other way, the owner's direction wins (`routemaker.agency_roads.overlay`), so the fix holds before and after the matching OSM edit reaches the extract. No sign excepting bicycles was reported and DC records no contraflow lane, so bicycles follow the one-way. Remove these entries only once DC's layer records the one-way and OSM's edit is in the extract: DC's own one-way never overrides an opposite OSM one-way.
